request.style: English, piano ballad, tender breathy female vocal, felt piano, warm strings, soft pads, slow build to a full final chorus, reflective and wondering, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
LORD, you have searched me and you know me
You know when I sit down and when I rise
You discern my thoughts from far away
You are familiar with all my ways

[Chorus]
Search me, O God, and know my heart
Test me and know my anxious thoughts
See if there is any offensive way in me
And lead me in the way everlasting

[Verse]
I tried to run where the dark is deep
Where the sea runs out and the shadows sleep
I rode the wings of the early dawn
But your hand was there as I travelled on
Even the darkness is not dark to you
The night shines like the day

[Chorus]
Search me, O God, and know my heart
Test me and know my anxious thoughts
See if there is any offensive way in me
And lead me in the way everlasting

[Verse]
Before my mother knew my face
You knit me in a hidden place
You wove my frame where no eye could look
And wrote my days into your book
I praise you, for I am awesomely and wonderfully made
Your works are wonderful; my soul knows it well

[Bridge]
How precious to me are your thoughts, O God!
How vast is their number!
If I could count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand
When I awake, I am still with you

[Chorus]
Search me, O God, and know my heart
Test me and know my anxious thoughts
See if there is any offensive way in me
And lead me in the way everlasting

[Outro]
Lead me in the way everlasting
